pageCache.pageTitle: Brinkworth Earl Danby’s CE Primary School - Headteacher's welcome - Mrs Kelly Butt
pageCache.text:
Headteacher's welcome - Mrs Kelly Butt
Welcome to Brinkworth Earl Danby’s CE Primary School, a warm and faith-centred community located in the beautiful Wiltshire countryside. Our school lies in the villages of Brinkworth and Dauntsey, equidistant between Malmesbury and Royal Wootton Bassett, and is easily accessible from Lyneham, Chippenham, and Hullavington.
Brinkworth Earl Danby’s is a loving school where every child belongs, is recognised, respected, and fostered to flourish. Children are at the heart of all we do, with their spiritual development central to our vision. We are committed to working in partnership with all of our families and the wider community, including the Parish of St Michael & All Angels, Brinkworth, and St James the Great, Dauntsey.
Rooted in our core Christian values – friendship, trust, thankfulness, perseverance, courage, and respect – and inspired by Ephesians 3:17, “Roots will grow down into God’s love and keep us strong,” we nurture resilience, compassion, and a love of learning and personal growth through teaching, worship, and reflection. Our school motto, ‘Believe to Achieve’, reflects our commitment to helping every child reach their God-given potential and grow in faith and character, preparing them for life with ambition, purpose, and connection.
Our mission is clear: “To provide a secure, happy and stimulating learning environment where EVERYONE is valued, spiritual growth is nurtured and potential maximised.”
Our School has been graded "Good" by Ofsted. The latest 2024 inspection highlighted the family feel of the school, the increased emphasis on high-quality teaching, positive progress across the broad and enriching curriculum, and dedication to pupil wellbeing. As the new permanent Headteacher, I am excited to build on these strengths and support the future growth and success of our school.
Whether you are a prospective family, a current family, or a visitor, I hope this website gives you a sense of the warmth, ambition, and joy that define our school. We warmly invite you to visit us in person, meet our dedicated staff and incredible children, and see what makes Brinkworth Earl Danby’s such an exciting and special place to learn and grow.
Mrs. Kelly Butt Headteacher

pageCache.text:
Aims, Ethos, Vision & Values
Our vision is:
Believe to Achieve! “Roots will grow down into God’s love and keep us strong” EPH 3:17
We believe as a community that each child can reach their vocational potential. We believe each child is of unique worth made in the image of God. We believe in each child being the best that they can be and finding their place in the world.
Our Christian values help us build a firm foundation, enabling us to grow into strong people building a better world.
Our Christian values are:-
a child's potential
being part of a community
being the best you can be
Friendship
Respect
Perseverance
Compassion
Our mission statement is:
To provide a secure, happy and stimulating learning environment in which EVERYONE is valued, spiritual growth is nurtured and potential maximised.
School Aims
Ethos
Our ethos underpins our unique culture and behaviour in our Church of England school. Our children are at the centre of every decision we make. We always ask "of what benefit will this be to our children? Will this help support them to be the best they can be?" We go the extra mile. Whether it is staff, parents, children, governors or community members, we choose to make that extra effort for a better outcome for individuals and for our school community.

pageCache.pageTitle: Brinkworth Earl Danby’s CE Primary School - Welcome to Our School
pageCache.text:
Welcome to Our School
The School
Brinkworth Earl Danby's School is a Church of England Voluntary Controlled Primary School. It was opened is 1992 as a result of the federation of two schools in adjacent villages - Brinkworth County Primary School and Earl Danby's School, Dauntsey. The federation of two schools means that both buildings are kept open but the original two sites run as one, with one headteacher, one governing body and one staff. The school is called Brinkworth Earl Danby's CE VC Primary School and we are a split site school. The sites are two miles apart, with both locations on spacious sites within beautiful rural North Wiltshire.
Both sites have a hard playing area and a good-sized playing field. The Reception Class has a covered play area, which allows them access to the outdoors whatever the weather.
At Upper Site, the classrooms are housed in purpose-built accommodation, which opened in 1993. The original school building has been upgraded and modernised to provide improved administration facilities and also houses the reference library and a hall, which is used for assembly, lunches and P.E.
During the summer of 2003, a multi use games area (MUGA) was constructed at the Upper Site, which enhanced facilities for PE. The MUGA is also used by the community for tennis, netball and village football out of school time.
A new purpose-built hall was completed at the Lower Site in December 2004 and officially opened in April 2005.
A new Link building, housing the Upper Site library, was added in 2005. It is also used for small group work and music lessons.
Our work on the 'Healthy School Programme' (click here to read more), has continued and we were recognised as a 'Silver' Healthy School in April 2021. We were also awarded the Silver Games Award in July 2021.
Our Lower Site buildings were refurbished in 2009 and the new outdoor area at Lower Site was completed in April 2011 and provides a wonderful extension to the learning environment for children in our Foundation and Key Stage 1 classes.
The Lower Site hall kitchen was extended in August 2015 and now provides much improved catering facilities.
The school has become popular with parents from a wide area and every child is respected, valued and encouraged to learn effectively in a variety of contexts. Members of the school community remain informed about the work of the school through regular newsletters and meetings. Parents are their children's first teachers and through working together we can achieve the best for every pupil.

However, "Every Day is an Open Day", so if you are unable to make one of our dedicated Open Days, we would be happy to welcome you at other times. If you would like to arrange a tour of our school, or if you have any questions, then please call our school office on 01666 510406 or email lowersite@brinkworthearldanbys.wilts.sch.uk.
At Brinkworth Earl Danby's Primary School we are proud to specialise in early years education. We nurture and inspire every child to be the very best they can be as they embark on their journey to becoming a happy and well-rounded member of society.

pageCache.pageTitle: Brinkworth Earl Danby’s CE Primary School - Wraparound Care
pageCache.text:
Wraparound Care
Kids Planet Out of School Club (OOSC)
Kids Planet provide a before and after school childcare provision. This is held in the Lower Site hall and is available to all pupils of Brinkworth Earl Danby’s, from Reception to Year 6.
Opening Hours
The morning session is from 7.30 am, with drop-off available at Kids Planet Brinkworth (SN15 5DX) or Lower Site. At the close of the morning session, pupils are handed to school staff for 8.45 am.
For their afternoon session, Upper Site pupils are transported to Lower Site, where they join the Lower Site pupils in the hall.
Collection for all OOSC pupils is from Lower Site only, before the close of the session at 6pm.
Food provision
Both morning and evening sessions include a food provision.
Booking
Please book directly with Kids Planet, further details can be found on their website
www.kidsplanetdaynurseries.co.uk/find-a-nursery/brinkworth/
They also offer a holiday club, which operates through the school holidays and for Brinkworth Earl Danby's TD days.
School Ethos and Behaviour Policy
Kids Planet fully supports the school’s ethos, values and behaviour policy. Pupils using the out of school service will experience a safe, welcoming and predictable environment.

pageCache.text:
Term Dates & Opening Hours
Due to our split sites we have staggered start to allow parents to drop/collect their children from the different sites:
Upper Site
8:20 am - gates open, parents may wait with their children on the playground
8:30 am - classrooms open, children may enter the classroom and start their morning task
8:40 am - registration (arrival after 8:50 am will be unauthorised)
3:00 pm - school finishes (32.5 hours per week)
Lower Site
8:45 am - gate open, children may enter the classroom and start their morning task
8:55 am - registration (arrival after 9:05 am will unauthorised)
3:15 pm - school finishes (32.5 hours per week)
There are a few occasions, such as end of term days, where the pick up time maybe be earlier.
